content.title: Appointment Policy
content.description: Appointments are scheduled based on availability. We require 24-hour notice for cancellations or rescheduling. Missed appointments without proper notice may result in a cancellation fee. Emergency appointments are available 24/7 for urgent eye care needs.

content.title: Payment and Insurance
content.description: Payment is due at the time of service unless prior arrangements have been made. We accept cash, credit cards, and most major insurance plans. Patients are responsible for understanding their insurance coverage and any co-payments or deductibles.

content.title: Medical Records
content.description: Medical records are maintained according to professional standards and legal requirements. Patients have the right to access their records and request copies. Records may be shared with other healthcare providers involved in your care with your consent.

content.title: Limitation of Liability
content.description: Dr. Alex Kisitu provides professional eye care services according to accepted medical standards. While we strive for optimal outcomes, we cannot guarantee specific results. Our liability is limited to the extent permitted by law.

content.title: Professional Standards
content.description: All services are provided according to professional optometric standards and applicable regulations in Uganda. We maintain appropriate professional liability coverage and follow established clinical protocols.

content.title: Modifications
content.description: These terms may be updated from time to time. Patients will be notified of significant changes. Continued use of our services constitutes acceptance of any modifications to these terms.
